scope: targeted primary-source check; no literature gains adopted as local measurements

sources.title: Beyond Token Savings: A Systematic Study of Context Compression in LLM Agents
sources.read_scope: abstract, sections 2-3, metrics and appendix links
sources.finding: Token use, per-task outcomes, cache-sensitive cost and end-to-end latency need separate evaluation. Summary generation itself adds model work; compression can change which tasks succeed.
sources.decision: Use as evaluation caution only. No lossy deletion or learned compression adopted. Author HTML is the pinned primary artifact; no companion author repository was identified in the inspected links. No claim of exhaustive literature search.

sources.title: OpenAI Prompt caching
sources.read_scope: response usage examples, cache monitoring and input-cost calculation
sources.finding: Track input, cached input, cache-write counts, latency and realized cost separately; actual pricing is required for monetary conversion.
sources.decision: Preserve observed native cache-write zero and cached-input zero. No price or cash bill inferred; do not subtract cache from input+output token totals.
